ndc_assessment.summary: "Montenegro's contribution to the international effort to avoid dangerous climate change is expressed [as a] 30% emission reduction by 2030 compared to the 1990 base year. The emission level of greenhouse gases for Montenegro from sectors covered by INDC was 5239 kilotons in 1990 and Montenegro pledges to reduce it at least by 1572 kilotons, to the level below or at 3667 kilotons. The reduction is to be achieved by general increase of energy efficiency, improvement of industrial technologies, increase of the share of renewables and modernization in the power sector."

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

progress.text: The national GHG inventory reports an emission level of 3470,94 kt CO2eq for 2022 (excluding LULUCF), representing a 27.60% reduction from 1990 levels (4793,16 kt CO2eq) which demonstrates that the country is on track to meet the target of the revised NDC for 2030.

target_text.text: The target is an Economy-wide GHG emission reduction target of 35% by 2030 compared to base year (1990) emissions, excluding Land Use, Land Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF).

reference_text.text: The base year is 1990 and the total national emissions excluding LULUCF in 1990 in the most recent recalculated GHG inventory are 4793.16 kt CO₂eq.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Third NDC, filed 2025-02-21. 68 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (22). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 4.4 MtCO₂e, DS-35 1.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 52.1 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 30% reduction (at least 1572 kilotons) in GHG emissions to the level below or at 3667 kilotons by 2030 compared to 1990 level (5239 kilotons) It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.46°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.15°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
